spans.s:
f. (-क्ष्मा)
The earth.
E.
क्षम to bear, Uṇādi affix अच्, and the penultimate dropped.

n. (-लं)
The surface of the earth.
E.
क्ष्मा, and तल below.

m. (-क्)
A king.
E.
क्ष्मा, and भुक् who enjoys.

m. (-भृत्)
1 A king, a prince.
2 A mountain.
E.
क्ष्मा the earth, and भृत् who nourishes, from भृ, affix क्विप्, तुक् added.

(ई) क्ष्मायी r. 1st cl. (क्ष्मायते)
To shake, to make tremble.

mfn. (-तः-ता-तं)
Shaken, trembling.
E.
क्ष्माय, and क्त aff.

mfn. (-ता-त्री-तृ)
Trembling, shaking.
E.
क्ष्माय, and तृच् aff.

r. 1st cl. (-क्ष्मीलति)
To wink or twinkle, to close as the eye lids.
